Success for All!
Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.
Welcome to Fairway School & Children's Centre!
As Headteacher, I am incredibly proud to lead a school where Nurturing Growth and Inspiring Success is at the heart of everything we do.
At Fairway, every child is known, valued and encouraged to be the very best version of themselves. We are a nurturing and inclusive school where children feel safe, happy and confident, and where everyone belongs. Through strong relationships, high expectations and a genuine commitment to every child’s wellbeing, we create an environment in which all children can thrive academically, socially and emotionally.
Our dedicated staff inspire a love of learning, celebrate individuality and help children develop the confidence, resilience and skills they need for the future. Fairway is more than a school; it is a caring community where children grow, succeed and flourish together.
I hope our website gives you a glimpse of what makes Fairway such a special place. We would be delighted to welcome you and your family to our school.
School Calendar & Events
Quick Links
Fairway School | Hosted by New Era Technology
This site uses cookies. Click here to find out more.

At Fairway School and Children’s Centre, we believe that the early years are the foundation of a lifelong love for learning. Our vision is to create a safe, inclusive, and nurturing environment where children from the age of two can grow in confidence, resilience, and curiosity.
We celebrate the uniqueness of every child and are committed to providing an environment where all children feel valued, respected, and supported. Through a balance of indoor and outdoor play, we encourage children to explore, imagine, and discover the world around them.
Our well-equipped classrooms and expansive outdoor spaces offer rich opportunities for hands-on learning, creative expression, and social development. Our experienced and caring staff are dedicated to fostering each child’s individual strengths and needs.
We aim to cultivate inquisitive minds, strong social skills, and a sense of wonder, ensuring that every child leaves us not only ready for the next stage of their educational journey but also with the joy and confidence to embrace it.
Together, we lay the stepping stones for children to become creative, confident, and compassionate learners—ready to thrive in school and beyond.

Applying for a Place at Fairway School
If you wish to apply for a place at Fairway School for your child, please contact the London Borough of Barnet's Primary Schools Admissions Team.
You can reach them at 020 8359 7651 or via the Barnet switchboard on 020 8359 2000.
You can also visit the Barnet Council website at www.barnet.gov.uk/school-admissions to access the application process and find further guidance.
Visiting Fairway School
We warmly invite you to visit our school to get a firsthand feel for the warm, nurturing environment we provide for our children.
If you would like to arrange a tour, please contact our school office on 020 8359 5380 or email us at office@fairway.barnet.sch.uk
Our dedicated staff and engaged pupils are excited to share our school's vibrant community and commitment to 'Nurturing Growth & Inspiring Success' in all we do.
We look forward to welcoming you to Fairway.
For more information on Nursery Admissions, Reception Admissions or Secondary Transfer, please click the relevent section below:

Starting School in September 2026
We look forward to welcoming you and your child to Fairway School. If you have any further questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.
Starting School in September 2027
Admissions to Reception
We are thrilled that you are considering Fairway School for your child's education. Our Reception Class is an important first step in their academic journey, and we strive to make the admissions process as smooth and welcoming as possible.
We warmly invite you to visit our school and experience firsthand the vibrant and nurturing atmosphere that defines Fairway. Our dedicated team is here to support you and your child every step of the way, ensuring a smooth and positive start to their educational journey.
For more information or to arrange a tour, please don't hesitate to contact our school office. We look forward to welcoming you and your family to the Fairway community.

Our school gate opens at 8:30am. During this time, parents must ensure their children are supervised until classroom doors open at 8:50am, when the register is taken. Children arriving after 9:00am will be marked as late and must enter the school through the main entrance via the office.
During morning break, we provide milk and fresh fruit for all children in Reception and Key Stage 1. Children in Key Stage 2 are welcome to bring their own healthy snack from home.
In the afternoon, the school gate opens at 3:15pm for parents to collect their children at 3:20pm. Any child not collected by 3:30pm will be taken to the school office, in line with our Late Collection Policy.
We offer a Breakfast Club from 8:00am, wraparound care until 4:00pm, and a range of after-school clubs running until 4:30pm—for more details, please visit our Clubs page.

At Fairway School, we believe that physical activity and sport play a vital role in supporting our pupils’ physical health, emotional wellbeing, and overall development. The PE and Sports Premium is additional funding provided by the government to improve the provision of physical education, physical activity, and sport in primary schools. This funding is designed to help schools make sustainable improvements that benefit all pupils.
We use this funding purposefully to enhance the quality and variety of our PE and sports offer, increase daily activity levels, and promote healthy, active lifestyles. Our approach includes investing in high-quality equipment, enriching our curriculum with a broad range of sports, supporting swimming and forest school, and encouraging active play throughout the school day.
On this page, you’ll find details about how we allocate our Sports Premium funding, the impact it is having, and how we evaluate its effectiveness. We are proud of the active, inclusive, and engaging environment we foster for every child at Fairway School.
Swimming
Our children have swimming lessons for one term in Y4, Y5 & Y6.
Swimming lessons are held on a Friday afternoon at Northway School Pool (right next door).
Lessons are 45 minutes long and run by qualified swimming instructors.
Pupils change in single-sex changing rooms and the lesson is observed by Fairway staff.
There is no school uniform for swimming but pupils are asked to wear sensible costumes (not bikinis) and trunks.
Swimming hats are compulsory and goggles are optional. Swimming kits should be taken home after each lesson.
We ask parents and carers for a financial contribution towards swimming and provide support for those who are unable to pay.
End of KS2 Swimming outcomes for 2025-2026 are available within our PE and Sports Premium Statement above.

At Fairway School, enrichment is an essential part of every child's journey, helping pupils discover new interests, develop confidence and build skills for the future. We are proud to offer a wide range of opportunities that extend learning beyond the classroom, including leadership roles such as Head Boys and Girls, School Council, Digital Leaders, Eco Warriors and French Ambassadors, alongside a variety of clubs and activities including Choir, Dance Club, Bollywood Club, Xylophone Club, Coding Club and Chess Club.
Pupils enjoy outdoor experiences through Forest School, gardening, camping and residential visits, while sporting opportunities include Bikeability, dance festivals and our outdoor gym. Through educational visits, cultural experiences, community projects, visiting speakers, STEM trips and our unique Fairway Duck Squad, every child is encouraged to develop responsibility, resilience, teamwork and ambition.
Our enrichment offer ensures that all pupils can explore their talents, broaden their horizons and create lasting memories throughout their time at Fairway.

We are proud of the achievements of our pupils and the progress they make throughout their time with us. Academic outcomes provide an important measure of attainment across different stages of school life, reflecting the hard work of our children, the dedication of our staff, and the strength of our curriculum.
This page provides an overview of our most recent assessment and statutory test results, celebrating the success of our pupils and their readiness for the next stage of their education.
KS2 SATS Outcomes 2026
At the end of Year 6, pupils complete national assessments in Reading, Mathematics, and Grammar, Punctuation and Spelling (GPS), while Writing and Science are assessed by teachers using evidence gathered throughout the year. These outcomes reflect pupils' achievement at the end of Key Stage 2 and the progress they have made during their time at primary school.
We are proud of our pupils' accomplishments, and our latest results can be viewed on this page.
Average scaled test scores (the range is 80 to 120)
Please note: The outcomes shown on this page are based on provisional data and have not yet been validated by the Department for Education (DfE). For the final validated performance data, please visit the DfE's Compare School and College Performance website.
Y1 Phonics Screening Check 2026
The Phonics Screening Check (PSC) is a statutory assessment taken by pupils in Year 1. It assesses children's ability to decode words using their phonics knowledge and helps identify those who may need additional support with early reading. Developing strong phonics skills is a key foundation for confident, fluent reading. Our results can be viewed below.
Y4 Multiplication Tables Check 2026
The Multiplication Tables Check (MTC) is a statutory assessment taken by pupils at the end of Year 4. It measures children's fluency in recalling multiplication facts up to 12 × 12, helping to ensure they have the strong mathematical foundations needed for future learning. Our results can be viewed below.
